відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\": \"1\", \"text\": \"I chose a straight-cut black suit (#573·11) as your foundation for this elegant evening in August, offering a timeless silhouette that feels confident without being stiff. Paired with a soft grey top (#423·22), the cool tone of the fabric adds a gentle contrast to the deep black of the suit, keeping your look fresh against the warm summer light and artificial glow of the restaurant. I selected burgundy leather belt (#604·04) and beige pumps (#448·06) with heels to elongate your line, while the brown crossbody bag (#89·35) introduces a rich, earthy warmth that bridges the cool grey and the deep black perfectly.\", \"how_to_wear\": [\"Tuck the top fully into the suit set to create a clean, continuous vertical line from chest to hem.\", \"Wear the belt over the high waist of the suit set to define your waistline clearly.\"], \"wrong_photos\": [{\"n\": \"#423·22\", \"why\": \"The photo shows different clothes in the frame that do not belong to this outfit.\"}, {\"n\": \"#573·11\", \"why\": \"The photo shows other clothes in it that are not part of her outfit.\"}, {\"n\": \"#604·04\", \"why\": \"The photo shows other clothes in it that are not in her outfit.\"}, {\"n\": \"#89·35\", \"why\": \"The photo shows other clothes in it that are not in her outfit.\"}, {\"n\": \"#448·06\", \"why\": \"The photo shows other clothes in it that are not in her outfit.\"}], \"swap\": {}, \"named\": [{\"n\": \"#573·11\", \"what\": \"the suit\"}, {\"n\": \"#423·22\", \"what\": \"the top\"}, {\"n\": \"#604·04\", \"what\": \"the belt\"}, {\"n\": \"#448·06\", \"what\": \"the pumps\"}, {\"n\": \"#89·35\", \"what\": \"the bag\"}], \"about_items\": [{\"n\": \"#423·22\", \"text\": \"This grey top brings a cool, muted tone to the ensemble. Its soft color contrasts beautifully with the deep black of the suit and provides a calm base that doesn't compete with the occasion's festive nature.\"}, {\"n\": \"#573·11\", \"text\": \"The straight-cut black suit offers a strong, elegant foundation for your wedding guest look. Its clean lines and dark shade provide a sophisticated backdrop that elevates the entire outfit to the appropriate level of formality for an evening celebration.\"}, {\"n\": \"#604·04\", \"text\": \"The burgundy leather belt adds a pop of rich color and helps define your waistline. This deep, wine-like hue connects well with both the grey top and black suit, adding warmth to the cool palette.\"}, {\"n\": \"#89·35\", \"text\": \"This brown crossbody bag provides an earthy, grounding element that harmonizes with the beige shoes and complements the warm tones of the burgundy belt. Its shape adds practicality for the restaurant evening while maintaining a polished look.\"}, {\"n\": \"#448·06\", \"text\": \"The beige pumps offer a soft transition between your outfit and the floor, elongating the leg line. Their neutral tone prevents the look from becoming too heavy, keeping it light enough for summer evening wear.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":4022,"output_tokens":761},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
